title: A Treatise on the Sounding Gale
summary: A treatise on the union of sound and wind in which the voice rides the moving air and the air carries the voice, ending in a tempest that sings.

title: Canon of the Thunder Voice
summary: A canon on sound joined to lightning in which the crack and the flash are one stroke, ending in a voice that is itself thunder.

title: Book of the Stone-Singing Deep
summary: A book on sound joined to earth in which stone is made to ring from its roots upward, ending in songs that break mountains and still them.
